title: The Eastern Wolf Pack
description: Thornfield pushed the cut east past the old markers and something back there has taken offense. Three men have quit the eastern lots and Elric cannot make quota short-handed. Greta Wolfsbane knows that ground - find her first.

objectives.description: Speak with Greta Wolfsbane about the ground you're walking into
Kill wolves denned in the eastern cut (0/8)
Kill the dire wolf holding the den

notes: Threat: three named-as-a-group loggers quit the eastern lots; Elric can't make quota. Cause distinct from tharins_wolf_problem (Elder Moor, ordinary wolves on the road, a trust test) and wolf_pack_menace (Thornfield, livestock loss at the farms south of town, a smarter pack, not the timber lots): this pack turned aggressive because Thornfield's own cut pushed into their den this season. Consequence (lost quota) unwired, recorded for later.
